en: A vintage black-and-white postcard showing a large, multi-story residential or institutional building with many windows and a tiled roof, likely from mid-20th century Europe. There are a few people standing outside the entrance. The reverse side features handwritten German text, a green Deutsche Bundespost stamp, a postmark from Bad Pyrmont, and printed information indicating DRK Mutter-Genesungs- und Kurheim Löwensen bei Bad Pyrmont (a German Red Cross convalescence and health home for mothers), and references to a museum in Schloss Bad Pyrmont.
